types.name: Data sources and collection methods
types.description: Asks about primary versus secondary data, questionnaire versus schedule, census versus sample, or a named method of collecting data.

types.name: Classification, tabulation and scales
types.description: Asks which kind of classification is used (geographical, chronological, qualitative, quantitative), the parts of a table, types of variable, or the scale of measurement.

types.name: Class limits, boundaries, marks and widths
types.description: Gives class intervals and asks for a class mark, class boundary, class width, cumulative or relative frequency, or the number of classes by Sturges' rule.

types.name: Bar diagrams and pie charts
types.description: Asks about a type of bar diagram or pictorial chart, or asks for the angle of a sector in a pie chart.

types.name: Histogram, polygon and ogive
types.description: Asks about drawing or reading a histogram, frequency polygon, ogive or Lorenz curve, including bar heights for unequal class widths.
